title: Events
content:
Upcoming Events

Explore our upcoming events designed to empower neurodivergent individuals, their families, and the professionals who support them. Gain valuable strategies and connect with experts to enhance executive function skills and achieve positive outcomes in everyday life.

The ADHD Support Blueprint for High School Students

SEPT. 9, 2024

3:30 PM (PT)

Event Description:

Explore our comprehensive resources and events designed to equip parents, educators, and professionals with the tools and strategies needed to support high school students with ADHD. Learn to foster positive outcomes and smoother transitions during these critical school years.

50 total seats available

Hosted by: Sean McCormick, M.S. Special Education and Founder of Executive Function Coaching Academy & EF Specialists

Speakers/Instructors: Sean McCormick, M.S. Special Education and Founder of Executive Function Coaching Academy & EF Specialists

Who it's for: Parents and educators looking to equip their high schoolers with crucial organizational and self-advocacy skills for academic and personal success.

Location: Online

Cost: $97. Learn more and register here.

Back to top

Fall 2024: Live Executive Function Coach Certification Course

SEPT. 30 OCT. 2, 7, 9, 14, 16, 2024

12:00 - 1:00 PM (PT)

Event Description:

This certification course prepares professionals to become executive function coaches, focusing on techniques for coaching middle school, high school, and college students. The course covers finding clients, tracking progress, setting goals, teaching executive function skills, and launching a coaching practice.

75 total seats available

Hosted by: Sean McCormick, M.S. Special Education and Founder of Executive Function Coaching Academy & EF Specialists

Speakers/Instructors: Sean McCormick, M.S. Special Education and Founder of Executive Function Coaching Academy & EF Specialists

Who it's for: Professionals who want to become certified executive function coaches and effectively support students with executive function challenges.

Location: Online

Cost: $897 - $997 (tiered pricing model). Learn more and register here.

Back to top

Annual International Conference on ADHD2024

NOV. 14 - 16, 2024

Event Description:

Join the ADHD community at the Annual International Conference on ADHD, where you can connect, learn, and thrive with others who understand ADHD. This event will feature dynamic sessions, practical support, and guidance for adults, families, and professionals, offering the latest research and strategies for managing ADHD.

Hosted by: ACO, ADDA, and CHADD

Speakers/Instructors: Leading experts in ADHD research and treatment, including keynote speakers like Dr. Sasha Hamdani and Penn Holderness.

Who it's for: This conference is ideal for adults with ADHD, coaches, professional organizers, educators, school professionals, parents, caregivers, medical professionals, and therapists. It provides practical, science-based information and strategies to support individuals with ADHD in various aspects of their lives.

Location: Hyatt Regency Orange County, Anaheim, CA

Cost: In-Person Conference: $450 - $1,050 (depending on registration type and timing). Learn more and register here.

Back to top

Executive Function Specialist Educator Certification Program

DEC. 2, 2024 & FEB 3, 2025

9:00 - 12:00 PM (PT)

Event Description:

Enhance your teaching with the Executive Function Specialist Certification. This program teaches educators how to identify, support, and improve students' executive function skills through structured modules on assessment, classroom strategies, collaboration, and personalized interventions.

75 total seats available

Hosted by: Sean McCormick, M.S. Special Education and Founder of Executive Function Coaching Academy & EF Specialists

Speakers/Instructors: Sean McCormick, M.S. Special Education and Founder of Executive Function Coaching Academy & EF Specialists

Who it's for: Educators and school professionals who want to integrate executive function skills into their teaching to better support student learning and success.

Location: Online

Cost: $897. Learn more and register here.

Back to top

Adult Executive Function Skills Live Cohort Course

JAN. 2025

DATES & TIMES TBD

Event Description:

This live course features six masterclasses designed to help neurodivergent adults develop essential executive function skills. Topics include planning, task initiation, organization, career launching, communication, and budgeting.

30 total seats available

Hosted by: Eric Kaufmann, M.S. Special Education and Co-founder of UpSkill Specialists

Speakers/Instructors: Eric Kaufmann, M.S. Special Education and Co-founder of UpSkill Specialists

Who it's for: Neurodivergent adults, parents, or conservators of neurodivergent adults, and professionals who want to enhance their executive function skills and achieve greater success in everyday life.

Location: Online

Cost: $497 (tiered pricing model). Learn more and register here.
author: ChrisHanson
